purpose: Select the 12 lived raw12 trunks and their designed trunkless cold counterparts for paper-facing score comparison without requiring human UI operation.

counterpartPopulationPolicy.ASQ: retain all available raw7 ASQ observations
counterpartPopulationPolicy.HQ: retain all available raw7 HQ observations
counterpartPopulationPolicy.FQ: retain all available raw7 FQ observations
counterpartPopulationPolicy.C: retain all available raw7 C observations
counterpartPopulationPolicy.note: raw7 contains C r1-r10 and ASQ/HQ/FQ r1-r3; retain multiplicity rather than silently subsampling C. Replicate-matched subsets may be derived explicitly later if desired.

itemMatching.rule: Do not require exact wording merely to retrieve a designed counterpart. Preserve wording/hash differences and flag them for the paper-facing comparison.

steps: Load or build the whole-corpus observation index.
Resolve the twelve raw12 anchors using this manifest.
Resolve each family's cold population from raw7.
Join lived and cold observations by canonicalItemId while preserving wording hashes and provenance.
Return the provenance-bearing selection and descriptive score table.
